sections.title: Channel selection
sections.description: Detector channels and micro-time range of the photons that enter the filter.

sections.label: Channels
sections.description: Detector routing channels to keep (comma/space separated; empty = all).

sections.label: µt range
sections.description: Micro-time range(s) to keep, e.g. 0-2048;2048-4095.

sections.title: Macro time interval
sections.description: Allowed inter-photon macro-time interval dMT (ms); photons outside the limits are dropped.

sections.label: min dMT (ms)
sections.description: Lower inter-photon-time threshold.

sections.label: use min
sections.description: Apply the lower dMT threshold.

sections.label: max dMT (ms)
sections.description: Upper inter-photon-time threshold; also the burst/count-rate time window.

sections.label: use max
sections.description: Apply the upper dMT threshold.

sections.title: Filter
sections.description: Count-rate filter: mode, minimum photons per window and window length; invert keeps the rejected photons.

sections.label: Mode
sections.description: burst / count-rate thresholding, or change-point burst detection (BOCPD / Kalman / CUSUM).

sections.label: enable
sections.description: Apply the burst/count-rate filter (channel/µt/dMT selections always apply).

sections.label: Min photons
sections.description: Minimum photons per burst (burst) / max photons in window (count-rate).

sections.label: Photon window
sections.description: Number of photons over which the local count rate is computed (burst mode).

sections.label: invert
sections.description: Invert the selection (keep the rejected photons).

sections.title: Change-point parameters (BOCPD / Kalman / CUSUM)
sections.description: Parameters of the change-point detectors (Bayesian online, Kalman, CUSUM) that segment the count-rate trace.

sections.label: Trace bin (ms)
sections.description: Bin width for the binned-intensity trace used by BOCPD/Kalman.

sections.label: Fill gaps
sections.description: Merge selected segments separated by up to 'Max gap' photons.

sections.label: Max gap
sections.description: Maximum gap (photons) bridged when filling gaps.

sections.label: BOCPD prior count
sections.description: Prior photon count for the BOCPD Gamma prior.

sections.label: BOCPD prior dur
sections.description: Time window assumed for the BOCPD prior count.

sections.label: BOCPD cp prob
sections.description: Probability of a burst start in any bin (BOCPD).

sections.label: Kalman Q
sections.description: Process-noise parameter (Kalman).

sections.label: Kalman R scale
sections.description: Measurement-noise scaling (Kalman).

sections.label: Kalman z-thresh
sections.description: Burst-detection threshold (Kalman).

sections.label: Kalman min len
sections.description: Minimum burst length in bins (Kalman).

sections.label: Kalman merge gap
sections.description: Maximum gap between bursts to merge (Kalman).

sections.label: CUSUM bg rate
sections.description: Background count rate in photons per second (Hz, not kHz); default 1000. A value far below the true background keeps no photon.

sections.label: CUSUM s/b ratio
sections.description: Expected signal-to-background rate ratio of a burst; 0 (default) estimates it from the data.

sections.label: CUSUM alpha
sections.description: False-alarm probability of the sequential test, 0-1 (default 0.05).

sections.label: CUSUM beta
sections.description: Missed-detection probability of the sequential test, 0-1 (default 0.05).
Summary of the photons kept and dropped by the current filter.

sections.title: Plot settings
sections.description: Binning and range of the plots below.

sections.label: MCS bin (ms)
sections.description: Bin width of the count-rate trace.

sections.label: Range lo
sections.description: First photon index shown in the dT plot.

sections.label: Range hi
sections.description: Last photon index shown in the dT plot (0 = all).
Histogram of inter-photon times dT with the min / max dMT limits; drag the lines to change them.
Count rate of all photons and of the photons kept by the filter.
